title: Task 1 — Construct & Save an HTML Webpage in Notepad
topic: Topic 3: Programming Fundamentals (Hypertext Markup Language - HTML)
apparatus: Computer, Printer, Notepad, and Web Browser (MS Word for code printout submission)
description: Write an HTML code in Notepad for the given webpage ('Impact of Computers on Society') and save it as an .html file. Note: The title of this webpage should be the candidate's name and ID.
solutionCode:
Impact of Computers on Society

The use of computers in a society has become widespread. You find them at schools, in shops, in banks, at airport, in hospitals, police departments and many other areas. They play a very important role in the society because of many advantageous functions they perform. Computers have made a very strong effect on every aspect of our life.

The important thing to remember is that a computer is a machine which takes in data, performs the operations as instructed and gives results.

title: Task 2 & Task 3 — HTML Font Formatting & Webpage Background/Text Colours
topic: Topic 3: Programming Fundamentals (HTML Text Formatting & Backgrounds)
description:
Task 2 (1 Mark): Set the font size '4', font colour 'Red' and font type 'Arial' for the heading line 'Impact of Computers on Society'.
Task 3 (1 Mark): Select black as the background colour and white as the colour of text of this webpage.

title: Task 4, Task 5 & Task 6 — JavaScript prompt(), Arithmetic Sum, document.write() & alert()
topic: Topic 3: Programming Fundamentals (JavaScript I/O & Arithmetic Operators)
description:
Perform the following tasks on a new saved HTML file using JavaScript:
• Task 4 (1 Mark): Ask the user to take two numbers from the user using prompt().
• Task 5 (1 Mark): Calculate their sum using the arithmetic operator.
• Task 6 (2 Marks): Display the result using document.write() on the browser ('Practical Model Paper - Sum of Two Numbers' / 'Sum: 40') and show the message 'Sum Calculated Successfully' in an alert() box.
solutionCode: Practical Model Paper - Sum of Two Numbers
